note: Generated by the Game Input Lab app from its own algorithms. Do not edit by hand.
coordinates: Offsets and touch positions use +y up. Units are points unless unitsPerPoint says otherwise.

exportSample.json:
{
  "format": "game-input-lab/joystick",
  "version": 1,
  "name": "Vector sample",
  "units": {
    "radius": "points (iOS pt, ≈ Android dp)",
    "deadZone": "percent of radius",
    "outerDeadZone": "percent of radius",
    "curve": "exponent applied after the dead zones",
    "sensitivity": "gain applied after the curve, output clamped to 1",
    "smoothing": "exponential smoothing time constant in milliseconds"
  },
  "config": {
    "mode": "fixed",
    "radius": 96,
    "deadZone": 0,
    "outerDeadZone": 30,
    "curve": 1.6,
    "sensitivity": 0.75,
    "smoothing": 0
  }
}

export.json:
{
  "format": "game-input-lab/tilt",
  "version": 1,
  "name": "Vector sample tilt",
  "units": {
    "orientation": "where the top edge of the phone points while playing: portrait, topLeft or topRight",
    "invertX": "flip left/right after the orientation is applied",
    "invertY": "flip up/down after the orientation is applied",
    "maxAngle": "degrees of tilt from the neutral pose that give a full push",
    "deadZone": "percent of maxAngle",
    "outerDeadZone": "percent of maxAngle",
    "curve": "exponent applied after the dead zones",
    "sensitivity": "gain applied after the curve, output clamped to 1",
    "smoothing": "exponential smoothing time constant in milliseconds"
  },
  "config": {
    "orientation": "topLeft",
    "invertX": false,
    "invertY": true,
    "maxAngle": 25,
    "deadZone": 8,
    "outerDeadZone": 4,
    "curve": 1.4,
    "sensitivity": 1.2,
    "smoothing": 60
  }
}

dualStickExport.json:
{
  "format": "game-input-lab/landscape-layout",
  "version": 1,
  "name": "Vector sample dual",
  "lab": "dualStick",
  "orientation": "landscape",
  "units": {
    "orientation": "landscape or portrait: which way the phone is held; the layout is for that one",
    "anchorX": "fraction of the safe area width, from the left",
    "anchorY": "fraction of the safe area height, from the bottom (y up, like a Unity anchor)",
    "visual": "visible button diameter in points",
    "hit": "touch (hit) diameter in points",
    "sticks": "same fields and units as game-input-lab/joystick; a stick ring is 2 × radius wide",
    "aim": "release: hold or forward; fireThreshold and slowWhileAiming are percents"
  },
  "controls": [
    {
      "id": "left",
      "kind": "stick",
      "anchorX": 0.22,
      "anchorY": 0.35
    },
    {
      "id": "right",
      "kind": "stick",
      "anchorX": 0.78,
      "anchorY": 0.35
    }
  ],
  "sticks": [
    {
      "id": "left",
      "mode": "fixed",
      "radius": 64,
      "deadZone": 10,
      "outerDeadZone": 0,
      "curve": 1,
      "sensitivity": 1,
      "smoothing": 0
    },
    {
      "id": "right",
      "mode": "fixed",
      "radius": 72,
      "deadZone": 8,

  }
}
